newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Sadia Group says mkt share up this year.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Sadia Group says mkt share up this year.

text.p: Brazilian food group Sadia said it has boosted market share in its main products this year versus 1995 while profitability rose in October.
Sadia Group said in a statement that it now holds a 51-percent share of the frozen industrialised meats market compared with 49 percent in 1995.
Its share of the refrigerated industrial meats market rose to 28.5 percent from 26.6 percent while its share of the margarines market climbed to 20 percent from 13.6 percent last year, it said.
The group, which includes Sadia Concordia S.A. and Sadia Oeste S.A. Industria e Comercio, also said it posted a "substantial recovery" in profitability in October.
The statement did not contain earnings figures but added a news conference is set for 1430 local/1630 gmt today to announce Sadia's 10-month results.
